verdict.rationale: Semgrep exposes a CLI and a limited AppSec Platform API for listing deployments, findings, and projects (semgrep-docs-17), and CLI scanning works well headlessly (semgrep-probe-5, semgrep-probe-7). However, no discoverable OpenAPI spec was found (semgrep-probe-2), and the documented MCP server failed to handshake in a live probe despite semgrep being installed (semgrep-probe-6), indicating the API/automation surface does not fully mirror UI capabilities like rule editing, triage workflows, or policy management.
